name: DCA Wine Country Trattoria Pan-Seared Salmon, New York Steak & Mashed Potatoes or Plain Pasta
brandOrRestaurant: Wine Country Trattoria (Performance Corridor · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: DCA's relaxed Tuscan table-service patio serves pan-seared salmon, grilled chicken breast, New York strip steak with mashed potatoes, and pasta tossed simply in olive oil and Parmigiano-Reggiano.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Pan-Seared Salmon or Bistecca Steak with mashed potatoes/white rice (no citrus or peppercorn sauce), or spaghetti with olive oil, broth, and grilled chicken.
watchOuts: Skip the Grapefruit Salad (1.0 hard citrus avoid!), Fried Calamari, and spicy red pepper flakes
